purpose: Native producer and analysis outputs bind the report; Python performs presentation only.

display_contract.primary_shared: Arithmetic mean of the three actual IC batch process costs divided by arithmetic mean of the three matched rho batch process costs; paired native 20,000-draw three-cohort bootstrap.
display_contract.primary_cold: Arithmetic mean actual singleton process IC cost divided by arithmetic mean matched rho cost over target_01 through target_08; native paired target-block bootstrap.
display_contract.secondary_queries: Native three-repetition target means and ratios for all 32 points; target-block and separately labeled crossed target/cohort sensitivity intervals.
display_contract.descriptive_spread: Native conventional midpoint medians, minima, p90, p95, maxima and complete tail/regression rows; no Python quantiles.
display_contract.cohort_costs: Each actual shared process has its own complete setup, target order, cumulative measured or modeled cost definitions and RSS; preparation occurs once per arm/cohort.
display_contract.break_even: Native additive coefficients, point threshold or null, bootstrap nonfinite mass and model coordinates; N>32 is extrapolated/model-only.
display_contract.correctness: Independent native receipts, witness replay counts, failures and meters; report binding is not a new certificate verification.
display_contract.missing_policy: Preserve native nulls, failures, censored values and withheld admission. Never replace absent values with zero or filter failed cases.

accounting.materialized_factor_base: K600 is already available; historical selection/construction cost remains unavailable and additive.
accounting.cold_start: Actual fresh process, without OS-cache flushing; includes parsing, setup, rank/logs, Q checks, solving, recovery, built-in verification and output.
accounting.reused_setup: Actual single 32-target process per arm/cohort; rho normal-basis and seed-specific jumps charged, no shared target-dependent collision table.
accounting.query_boundary: Stock IC target_ms omits Q-validation/input/output intervals that rho online includes; queries remain secondary.
accounting.external_audit: Post-hoc native correctness audit, metered separately outside both solver intervals.

figure_contracts.workflow: Static diagram of actual singleton and reused-setup execution boundaries; no measured numbers until native results.
figure_contracts.complete_process_costs: All 8 paired cold costs and all 3 paired genuine 32-target batch costs, with units and native admission status.
figure_contracts.query_points: All native per-target query means and all 3 values per arm; mismatch disclosed, 32 target blocks and 3 shared setups.
figure_contracts.query_spread: Supplied native medians/p90/p95/max, or direct plotting of raw observations; no renderer-computed statistics.
figure_contracts.memory: All recorded wait4 process RSS and CPU observations, separately from wall time.
figure_contracts.model: Native precomputed model points, native finite/nonfinite threshold status and measured-count range clearly marked.
figure_contracts.aa: Five native same-arm process ratios, median/minimum/maximum; descriptive noise, not a confidence band.
